title: Calculate Huffman Compression Cost
real_world_story: A data-compression system needs to reduce the number of bits required to transmit a collection of symbols. Symbols that occur more frequently should receive shorter binary codes.

real_world_connection.input_represents: Frequency of each symbol in the data
real_world_connection.target_represents: Minimum total number of bits required to encode all symbols using Huffman coding
real_world_connection.algorithm_represents: Repeatedly combining the two least frequent symbols to construct an optimal prefix-code tree

problem_statement: Given the frequencies of N symbols, calculate the minimum total cost of constructing a Huffman code. At each step, combine the two smallest frequencies and add their sum to the total cost. Continue until only one frequency remains.
task: Use Huffman coding to calculate the minimum total number of bits required to represent the given symbol frequencies.
input_format: The first line contains an integer N, the number of symbols. The second line contains N space-separated positive integers representing the frequency of each symbol.
output_format: Print a single integer representing the minimum total Huffman encoding cost.

examples.explanation: The frequencies are combined as 5+9=14, 12+13=25, 14+25=39, giving a total cost of 14+25+39=78.
Repeatedly combining the two smallest frequencies produces a minimum total Huffman cost of 77.

expected_algorithm.name: Huffman Coding
expected_algorithm.reason: Huffman coding repeatedly combines the two least frequent symbols to construct an optimal prefix-code tree with minimum weighted encoding cost.

hint: Insert all frequencies into a min heap.
Add their sum to the total cost and insert the sum back into the heap.
Continue until only one value remains.
real_world_takeaway: Huffman coding reduces storage and transmission requirements by assigning shorter codes to frequently occurring symbols while preserving the original information.
